features.text: PDAC APPROVED L1951: Certified spiral-style AFO designed for dynamic mobility and dorsiflexion support.
ENERGY-RETURNING DESIGN: Carbon and glass fiber composite stores and releases energy for efficient gait movement.
DYNAMIC FLEX SUPPORT: Promotes natural heel-to-toe transition, improving stride and reducing fatigue.
LIGHTWEIGHT LOW-PROFILE CONSTRUCTION: Fits easily under clothing and inside most footwear for discreet daily use.
CUSTOMIZABLE FIT: Dual hook-and-loop straps allow secure adjustment for both left and right legs.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
